title: Fresh Fire Ignites the River Church
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner celebrates the River Church of Kansas City's answered prayers and the fresh fire of the Holy Spirit that's being poured out on its leaders and members. You won't want to miss this inspiring message of gratitude and vision, as Pastor Chris lifts up the church's pastors and prays for a new level of impartation and unity to propel them forward in 2026. As you listen, you'll be encouraged to pray with fresh faith and vision for your own life and ministry.
